name: openworks
description: Open-process: work in progress as an addressable surface that humans and agents can reference, comment on, and disagree about while it is still in motion.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter openworks-browser typecheck && tsc -p convex/tsconfig.json && tsc -p convex/tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @openworks/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @openworks/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @openworks/node typecheck && pnpm --filter openworks-site typecheck
scripts.site:deploy: pnpm site:build && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name=openworks --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.site:build: pnpm site:demo && pnpm --filter openworks-site build && rm -rf site/dist/demo && cp -R browser/dist-demo site/dist/demo

author: Seonglae Cho
